# AD FutureStack (adfuturestack.dev)
> Modern IT Services, Software Development & Product Engineering Studio

AD FutureStack is a software development studio specializing in enterprise product engineering, custom web & mobile applications, AI workflow automation, and scalable multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

## Core Services
- Web Development: Fast, responsive, scalable web applications (React, Next.js, Node.js, REST & GraphQL APIs).
- App Development: Intuitive mobile experiences for iOS and Android (React Native, Flutter, Cloud Backends).
- AI & Workflow Automation: Autonomous AI agent orchestration, n8n workflows, RAG pipelines, and enterprise application integration.
- Digital Marketing & SEO: Search engine optimization, demand generation, web performance, and growth engines.
- Multi-Tenant SaaS Engineering: Secure SaaS platforms with tenant data isolation, role-based security, and automated subscription billing.

## Enterprise Solution Blueprints
- Enterprise Multi-Tenant SaaS Blueprint: Pre-engineered SaaS architecture foundation with tenant isolation and Stripe billing.
- AI Workflow Automation Suite: Autonomous AI agents connecting LLMs to enterprise ERP/CRM systems.
- High-Throughput API Gateway & Streaming: Sub-20ms low latency API routing, Kafka streaming, and Prometheus telemetry.
- FinTech Payment & Compliance Platform: Double-entry ledger, PCI-DSS compliance, fraud scoring, and KYC/AML workflows.

## Technical Capabilities & Matrix
- Microservices & APIs: Java Spring Boot, Node.js, Go, gRPC, Apache Kafka, Redis.
- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines.
- Data Architecture: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, MongoDB, Snowflake, Apache Spark.
- Zero-Trust Security: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML SSO, SOC2 & ISO 27001 readiness.
